description: Send a one-time verification code (OTP) by SMS or email to a phone number in Israel using Otipi, in test mode. Use this to try the login/2FA flow end to end. With a test key the message really arrives ONLY if the recipient was confirmed with add_test_recipient + confirm_test_recipient; otherwise it is kept in the sandbox log and nothing is delivered. The result says which case happened and includes test_code when available, so you can verify it with verify_otp. Each account has 5 free test SMS for life.

app.description: Brand name shown in the message, for example "MyApp". Max 40 characters.

to.description: Israeli mobile number in E.164 format +9725XXXXXXXX (05XXXXXXXX is also accepted), or an email address for the email channel.

name: send_test_otp
